title: Redssentials
description: This is a plugin made by me and ChatGpt. Just a essentials type thing. Stuff in src will be changed later but yea
body:
"**RedPlugin - Essential Commands for Minecraft**

RedPlugin is a feature-rich Minecraft plugin designed to enhance your gameplay experience with a suite of essential commands and functionalities. Whether you're running a server or just playing with friends, RedPlugin offers vital tools to manage and customize your game.

**Key Features:**

Gamemode Management: Easily switch between Creative, Survival, Spectator, and Adventure modes with a simple command. Customize player experiences and make game management a breeze.
Flight Control: Toggle flight mode for players to enable or disable flying, perfect for creative building or exploration.
Healing: Heal players instantly with the heal command, ideal for quickly recovering health during intense gameplay.
Time Control: Set the in-game time to Day or Night with the time command, giving you control over the game environment.

**Permissions:**

redssentials.fly - toggles fly or somin ig
redssentials.gamemode - changes gamemode
redssentials.heal - heals you or a target
redssentials.time - sets a time to day or night

**Compatibility:**

Designed for Minecraft 1.20.x
Installation:

Place the JAR file into your server’s plugins folder.
Restart your server to enable the plugin.
With Redssentials, you get a reliable and customizable set of commands to manage your Minecraft server efficiently. Enhance your gameplay and server management with essential tools from Redssentials!" - ChatGPT (thx <3)
